rules: Do not include a subjective acceptance conclusion in a Luna packet.
Do not turn a source or static finding into a runtime defect without execution evidence.
Preserve passing sibling identities and unchanged candidate evidence.
Escalate identity, path, contract, schema, save/migration, cross-lane, and subjective boundaries.
Use null for candidate-bound fields until Integration admits an exact renderer candidate.
